steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Switch the event type to a reverse auction with a buy-oriented rank strategy.
Apply the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product with a normal initial quantity before clearing it in the sheet.
Set the requested delivery location for the first line item.
Clear the requested quantity to reproduce the blank-quantity case.
Verify that the blank quantity is not accepted and is marked or handled as an invalid cell value.
Add one available QA test vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Attempt to publish the otherwise complete event with the invalid blank quantity.

args.contains: Please fill valid quantity on every line item

steps.note: Assert that publishing is refused with the quantity validation error.
